description: This file defines the ARCZonalShiftClient class, which is a client used to interact with the AWS ARC - Zonal Shift service by providing method definitions to perform various operations related to zonal shifts, including starting, updating, listing, and deleting zonal shifts and related configurations.

classes.name: ARCZonalShiftClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with the AWS ARC - Zonal Shift service, extending from AwsClient, providing methods to perform various zonal shift operations.

methods.name: cancelZonalShift
methods.description: Initiates the cancellation of a zonal shift.

methods.name: cancelZonalShiftAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initiates the cancellation of a zonal shift.

methods.name: createPracticeRunConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new practice run configuration.

methods.name: createPracticeRunConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new practice run configuration.

methods.name: deletePracticeRunConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes an existing practice run configuration.

methods.name: deletePracticeRunConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a practice run configuration.

methods.name: getAutoshiftObserverNotificationStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of autoshift observer notification.

methods.name: getAutoshiftObserverNotificationStatusAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the status of autoshift observer notification.

methods.name: getManagedResource
methods.description: Retrieves information about a managed resource.

methods.name: getManagedResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a managed resource.

methods.name: listAutoshiftsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists autoshifts.

methods.name: listManagedResources
methods.description: Lists managed resources.

methods.name: listManagedResourcesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists managed resources.

methods.name: listZonalShifts
methods.description: Lists zonal shifts.

methods.name: listZonalShiftsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists zonal shifts.

methods.name: startZonalShift
methods.description: Starts a zonal shift.

methods.name: startZonalShiftAsync

methods.name: updateAutoshiftObserverNotificationStatus

methods.description: Asynchronously updates the autoshift observer notification status.

methods.description: Asynchronously updates a practice run configuration.

methods.description: Updates the zonal autoshift configuration.
